"''It's an old Republic medical station abandoned after the Clone Wars.|Ezra Bridger and Sabine Wren|}} Amid the [[time]] of the [[Clone Wars]], a '''''Haven''-class medical station''' was utilized by the [[Galactic Republic]] as a [[Medcenter|medical center]] and located in [[Sector 11 (location)|Sector 11]]. However, sometime during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] following the war's [[Mission to Mustafar|end]], the [[space station]] was decommissioned, with several systems becoming corrupted over time. Later, in [[4 BBY]], the [[Haven-class medical station|''Haven''-class medical station]] was visited by members of the [[Spectres]], who were in search of medical supplies for their allies in the [[Phoenix Cell|Phoenix rebel cell]]. However, during their mission, the rebels were [[Skirmish aboard a Republic medical station|ambushed]] by the [[Fifth Brother]] and [[Seventh Sister]] of the Empire's [[Inquisitorius]]. Despite the efforts by the [[Inquisitor]]s to capture their adversaries, the rebels were able to escape with a crate of supplies, returning to the rebellion afterward. ==Description== Like other [[space station]]s of its class,{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}} the [[Haven-class medical station|''Haven''-class medical station]] consisted of an elongated central shaft with eight spokes that formed the [[Republic crest]] when viewed from above. Despite having been abandoned for some time by the time members of the [[Spectres]] visited in [[4 BBY]], the station was still in good enough shape to be fully powered up, even though there was garbage strewn throughout the hallways. The station also still possessed medical supplies that could be salvaged. ==History== The medical station was built for use by the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] After the [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] of the [[The galaxy|galaxy-spanning]] conflict, the station was abandoned, although in good condition with useful medical supplies still onboard. In [[4 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire]] sent [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitors]], [[Force-sensitive]] agents, to hunt down the [[Jedi]] members of the Spectres, a crew of rebels who were part of the [[Phoenix Cell]]. One of the Inquisitors, [[Seventh Sister]], planted [[ID9 seeker droid]]s in the station to monitor it, as she felt that the rebels might appear there. Meanwhile, with the rebels in need of medical supplies, [[Hera Syndulla]], leader of the Spectres, dispatched [[Garazeb Orrelios]], [[Sabine Wren]], and [[C1-10P|Chopper]] to search the station, based on intel from [[clone trooper]] [[Captain]] [[Rex]], who also gave them access codes for the station. [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]], desperate for a chance to briefly escape his [[Jedi training]], decided to come along as well, and the group departed on the [[shuttle]] ''[[Phantom]]''. [[File:Seventh_Sister_Interrogating.png|thumb|left|250px|The Seventh Sister interrogates Bridger in the station control room.]] Arriving at the station, the ''Phantom'' landed in a [[hangar]] after the access codes worked to open the door. The rebels ventured deeper into the station, with Wren in particular unnerved by the station's atmosphere, which she found creepy. Bridger suggested the station as a potential base for the Phoenix rebels, but Wren shot his idea down. Reaching a control room, Wren had Chopper activate a terminal, but the [[astromech droid]] instead turned on power to the entire station before Wren had him switch most of it off. The brief power surge triggered alarms on the [[Star Destroyer]] that Imperial [[Admiral]] [[Kassius Konstantine]], [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus]], and the Inquisitor [[Fifth Brother]] were aboard. Fifth Brother, sensing that a Jedi was likely involved, refused assistance and set off by himself for the station. Chopper searched the station's computers for the location of any remaining supplies, but found that the computers' remaining data had become corrupted and unreadable, so the rebels split up and began searching for themselves. Orrelios and Bridger, getting into an argument, missed a storage room containing crates of medical supplies as they decided to race each other to see who could find supplies first. Wren was spotted by some of the seeker droids, but did not notice she was being watched. The droids subsequently alerted Seventh Sister of the intruders, before one lured Chopper into a trap and electrocuted him, using the droid to send a distress transmission to the other rebels. The two Inquisitors arrived at the station around the same time, each unaware of the other's presence, and began seeking out the rebels. Bridger and Wren entered a ventilation shaft in order to reach Chopper quickly; Orrelios attempted to follow but, being much larger, became stuck. Upon getting to the upper level, Bridger and Wren quickly encountered the Seventh Sister and her droids, and were overwhelmed and forced to flee. During their flight, they encountered the Fifth Brother and were subsequently separated when Bridger sealed a door in order to assist Wren in escaping. The Padawan was subsequently captured, with the Seventh Sister making it clear to her colleague that they could capture the other rebels if they kept him alive. ==Behind the scenes== The medical station first appeared in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|season 2]] episode "[[Always Two There Are]]." ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Always Two There Are}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|23|Databank A-Z}} *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/always-two-there-are|text="Always Two There Are" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} *{{BuildFalconCite|73|Secrets of Spaceflight}} *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-inside-intel-the-inquisitorius|text=''Star Wars'' Inside Intel: The Inquisitorius|int=Star Wars Inside Intel}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{Facebook|username=starwarsrebels|url=starwarsrebels/photos/a.230754950414469.1073741828.180356405454324/514414028715225|name=Star Wars Rebels|date=01-11-2015|quote=This station was anything but a safe haven for the Rebels.|archivefile=File:Haven-class-Canon-November-2-2015.png}} [[Category:Deep space stations]] [[Category:Haven-class medical stations]]
